name: thumb roll
note: plan 42 lab idea 13: put both thumbs on the touchpad and the shape stutters on the beat (LFO 1, a square on the clock, blanking its lines and points); the second thumb's height picks the roll — low 1/4, middle 1/8, high 1/16; lift a thumb and it stops. R4 latches it: right-click Env 6's gate → Learn pad, press R4. The light bar blinks with the shape: a sink row of your own (session-rows/thumb-roll.json): right-click view.lines_alpha → Learn sink ▸ light bar level
